articles.headline: Green Circle Decarbonize Technology Limited Announces 1-for-6 Share Consolidation to Become Effective on October 7, 2026
articles.summary: Green Circle announces a planned one-for-six share consolidation effective October 7, following prior shareholder approval. The September 23 announcement is news at entry, while the later effective date does not mean the consolidation had already occurred.
